correctness.rationale: The two-round EF argument proves the exact equivalence for finite nonempty multitournaments; the odd complete graph two-factor construction and degree bound give the exact 2^k+1 minimal saturated model. Conditional on the common edge, the two one-vertex deficiency indicators are independent with constant conditional rate by color symmetry, yielding the exact variance. In the window n/2^k=2 log(2^k)+log log(2^k)+c+o(1), first and second missing-coupon Bonferroni terms and uniform conditioning on the finite induced subgraph of r marked vertices yield factorial moments (2e^{-c})^r. The checked standalone Python file reports ALL_CHECKS_OK on 5,262 enumerated finite structures and six optimal constructions; finite checks are only corroboration.

originality.rationale: Searched exact local orientation-profile formulas, an all-vertex signature-coverage extremal model, fixed-vocabulary rank-two limits and growing-vocabulary Poisson thresholds, including their graph-coloring/coupon-collector equivalents. The closest current multi-successor papers concern sparse successor paths and satisfiability rather than complete tournament relations and random profiles. The closest published tournament findings concern reversal reducts or Ramsey spectrum cutoffs, neither logically implies the complete local-profile characterization, the q+1 saturated witness or the e^{-2e^{-c}} window. Standard combinatorial/probabilistic lemmas are credited, and a general coverage theorem remains a historical-priority risk.
